title: Change PIN
summary: Changes the account PIN (senha de 8 números) from Sua conta. A biometric check comes first; no old PIN is needed (ADR 0057). The server checks the new PIN, unblocks it and cancels any waiting PIN reset.

phase.description: confirmIdentity: the biometric check. create and confirm: the signup-pin steps. saving: PUT /v1/me/pin runs. failed: see error. done: bipe_pin_changed.

pin.description: Digits typed in this step. Never logged.

problem.description: As in signup-pin. pin_weak from the server maps to the same values.

confirmIdentity.effect: Asks for the approval owner check (bipe#785, security.md rules 5 and 14): biometrics only, with no passcode fallback (Android: BIOMETRIC_STRONG, class 3); a phone with no biometrics set up asks for the Bipe PIN (bipe_pin_enter_title), checked by POST /v1/me/pin/check, where wrong tries count against the account (bipe_pin_wrong with tries left, bipe_pin_blocked_body); a phone with no screen lock is refused and the screen closes. bipe_pin_change_biometric_reason is the biometric reason. A pass sets create; a fail or cancel closes the screen.

typeDigit.effect: The signup-pin steps: pinProblem() at the end of create, a match check at the end of confirm. A match sets saving and calls save.

save.effect: PUT /v1/me/pin with the PIN. 204: while the app lock is on and the phone holds one account, also sets the app lock PIN (app-lock); success haptic (use pin_set); shows bipe_pin_changed and closes. 400 pin_weak: sets problem from reason and goes back to create. 429: failed with bipe_error_rate_limited.

retry.effect: From failed: calls save again with the same PIN while the screen is open.

notes: No old PIN: the biometric check on the signed-in phone stands in for it (ADR 0057). A phone with no biometrics uses the Bipe PIN, never the phone's passcode or the app lock PIN (bipe#785).
The server sends a notice to the verified recovery email after a change (api/openapi.yaml /v1/me/pin). The app shows nothing about it.
There is no remove-PIN action. Every account has a PIN (ADR 0057, ADR 0112).
With two accounts on the phone (ADR 0086), this changes the PIN of the active account only. The app lock PIN does not change.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.setPIN (BipeKit); BipeApiClient.setPin, BipeDeviceAccount and BipePin (libraries/bipe api and account); pinProblem() from the generated code.
